rules.obligation_text: Personal data may only be processed where the data subject has given valid consent, or another lawful basis applies.
rules.recommendation: Stop processing the record until consent is obtained, or delete it.

rules.obligation_text: Personal data must not be kept longer than is necessary for the purpose it was collected for, and must be deleted or anonymised once that period ends.
rules.recommendation: Delete or anonymise the record, since its retention period has ended.
